ValidationRule.description: Notes may have at most 50 line breaks, no tab or leading-space characters, and cancelled projects need a real explanation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled'), LEN(TRIM(BLANKVALUE(Notes__c, ''))) < 20), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Notes__c)), OR( LEN(Notes__c) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE(Notes__c, BR(), '')) > 50, CONTAINS(Notes__c, CHR(9)), LEFT(Notes__c, 1) = CHR(32) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Notes violate line-break/whitespace rules or a cancelled project lacks an explanation.
